outcome: Mode of delivery (cesarean section, instrumental vaginal delivery)
cohort: 70 primigravid women at term with a single fetus in cephalic presentation in active labor
finding: Epidural analgesia effectively alleviated labor pain without increasing cesarean section or instrumental vaginal birth rates, and was associated with high patient satisfaction and no adverse effects on neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: While epidural analgesia did not increase the rates of cesarean section or instrumental vaginal birth, it was associated with a slightly prolonged second stage of labor.
